name: MIRE-2: Anomalous Flash/EEPROM Memory Checksums Detected
description: The on-board Checksum app reports integrity monitoring disabled — the effect of an attack that turned off memory/EEPROM checksumming. Read from the memory telemetry partition.
query:
FROM logs.ecs.spacecraft.memory
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 hour AND fswApp == "CS" AND (cs.checksumState == "DISABLED" OR cs.eepromState == "DISABLED")
| KEEP @timestamp, fswApp, cs.checksumState, cs.eepromState, cs.memoryState
| LIMIT 100
author: Elastic
false_positives: An authorized checksum reconfiguration during maintenance disables it briefly. Tune per mission via detection exceptions at deployment.
note:
## SPARTA Investigation Guide

### Detection logic
An ES|QL rule over the memory telemetry that flags the CS app reporting checksum or EEPROM integrity monitoring disabled — the effect of a CS-disable command or a tampering attempt.

### Framework reference
- **Tactic:** Execution
- **Technique EX-0004:** [Compromise Boot Memory](https://sparta.aerospace.org/technique/EX-0004/)
- **Indicator of Behavior MIRE-2:** On-board memory checksum state anomalous (integrity monitoring disabled).

### Indicators of Behavior
- **MIRE-2: On-board memory checksum state anomalous (integrity monitoring disabled).**

### How to validate this alert
Correlate the timing with a CS-disable or memory command and the attributed hazardous rule. Integrity monitoring off on a live spacecraft is high-severity. See spartastixkb.
